decision.reason: Fresh endpoint-index evidence identifies search-web as a distinct US$0.02 endpoint with num_results control. That evidence must not resolve the existing price conflict for the generic AgentUtility Search record because /search and /search-web are distinct endpoint scopes. search-web can be evaluated separately for locked top-5 equivalence, but only a fresh policy-compliant raw 402 can establish executable quote terms and only paid identical-task outcomes can populate ranking metrics.
